title: Jonah Runs from God
summary: Running from God does not hide us from His care or His command. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Jonah 1:1-17 and look for how this passage teaches: Running from God does not hide us from His care or His command.

tell_it: God told Jonah to go to Nineveh, but Jonah ran the other way. God sent a storm and a great fish.
understand_it: Running from God does not hide us from His care or His command. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Jonah Runs from God reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Obedience matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Jonah Runs from God shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Running from God does not hide us from His care or His command.
teen_explanation: Jonah Runs from God gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that running from God does not hide us from His care or His command. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Running from God does not hide us from His care or His command.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when obedience is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Where did God tell Jonah to go?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Nineveh. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that running from God does not hide us from His care or His command.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Jonah 1:2 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Jonah Runs from God?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Which Way Jonah
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Running from God does not hide us from His care or His command.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Jonah Runs from God. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
